versions.changelog:
Initial release of pymupdf skill:

- Enables rendering PDF pages to high-quality images (PNG, JPG, PPM).
- Supports extraction of embedded images from PDF files.
- Provides PDF annotation, redaction, and advanced inspection tools.
- Dedicated CLI script for deterministic operations (export-images, extract-images, info).
- Guides users to use pypdf skill for text extraction, splitting, merging, and rotating.
